freeze_mechanism_rationale: allow_auto_merge is false and the ruleset has zero bypass actors, so main advances only by deliberate human/agent merge of a PR that already passed 9 required contexts. There is no automated merger to pause. Options 1-3 would require creating or altering a repository ruleset, which both the standing operator constraints and section 1 forbid; section 1 directs a coordinated merge hold instead of inventing a settings change.
restoration_required: none — no governance object is altered; the hold is operational and ends when the operator resumes merging
